referencePatternsToCopy.label: Event detail and RSVP flow
referencePatternsToCopy.whatToCopy: Copy an event detail layout: title, date/time, location, host, capacity/status chip, attendee context, RSVP action, and confirmation state.

referencePatternsToCopy.label: Material Design cards and lists
referencePatternsToCopy.whatToCopy: Use cards/lists only as scannable containers with clear hierarchy, content, metadata, and actions. Do not use repeated cards as the whole primary workflow.

referencePatternsToCopy.label: Flutter sample app implementation patterns
referencePatternsToCopy.whatToCopy: Copy the separation between app shell, route state, domain widgets, and testable UI states rather than hardcoding a single generic renderer.

referencePatternsToCopy.label: Material navigation and information architecture
referencePatternsToCopy.whatToCopy: Organize screens by user jobs and destinations; keep primary actions visible and avoid exposing implementation taxonomy.

referencePatternsToCopy.label: Apple HIG navigation and content organization
referencePatternsToCopy.whatToCopy: Make navigation predictable, content-centered, and appropriate for the user’s current task.

findings.visibleTextBasis: The current screenshots visibly repeat implementation-style decision scaffolding. The exact visible text appears on 48 action/review screens: "Decision", "Use the object details below to save, submit, send, pay, or export the right community record", "Change or reject", and "Saved status and receiver". This is not a real community interaction model and directly contradicts the B25 bar against workflow harness surfaces.
productDocOrBlueprintBasis: docs/Build Plan V2/Evidence/B25/production-ux-blueprint.md: B25 requires production community product surfaces, modern UI, domain-native primary workflows, and no major repeated-card/checklist/thin-content defects.

Community product docs Sections 5, 6, and 9 define domain-native surfaces and reject checklist modals, generic validation cards, abstract payment rows, technical-only export rows, and generic workflow surfaces.
findings.requiredFix: Replace the shared action/review checklist renderer with domain-specific decision screens. Each affected workflow must show the concrete object, decision data, natural primary action, real alternate/change/reject path, and a durable result/receiver state using copy specific to that community task. Remove the generic Decision/Change-or-reject/Saved-status checklist text from user-facing UI and recapture entry/action/result screenshots.

findings.visibleTextBasis: Across the 195 screenshots, visually distinct community tasks collapse into stacked rounded cards with similar chip rows, large dark panels, and single-hue community themes. Garden RSVP, HOA decisions, Masjid care, soccer roster, chess results, camera critique, social messages, ad-off, and export workflows differ mostly by color/title text. B25 requires modern, domain-native app surfaces organized around real community content rather than a universal card-stack renderer.
productDocOrBlueprintBasis: docs/Build Plan V2/Evidence/B25/production-ux-blueprint.md: B25 requires production community product surfaces, modern UI, domain-native primary workflows, and no major repeated-card/checklist/thin-content defects.

Community product docs Sections 5, 6, and 9 define domain-native surfaces and reject checklist modals, generic validation cards, abstract payment rows, technical-only export rows, and generic workflow surfaces.
findings.requiredFix: Introduce domain-specific layouts and information architecture per surface family: event detail pages, announcement composer/feed/inbox, donation/payment receipt, protected request form, roster/schedule views, document center, message thread, ad/no-fill placement, and export wizard. Vary layout, hierarchy, density, and actions by job while preserving shell consistency. Reduce card nesting, improve contrast, and make primary content visible without repetitive framework panels.
findings.description: The full screenshot set has repeated-card fatigue and weak modern product differentiation.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does the whole experience feel like a real production community app for the target users, not merely an implemented workflow harness?
holisticQuestionAnswers.screenshotBackedEvidence: 48 screenshots include generic action/review checklist text such as Decision, Change or reject, Saved status and receiver, and "Use the object details below to save, submit, send, pay, or export the right community record."
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Remove workflow-harness action scaffolding and implement domain-native decision surfaces per workflow.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Is the UI modern, easy to use, easy to navigate, and visually appealing for the target persona?
holisticQuestionAnswers.screenshotBackedEvidence: The screenshots use consistent typography and colors, but the visual system is dominated by near-identical stacked cards, dense chip rows, dark panels, and low-contrast lower action sections across unrelated communities.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Differentiate layouts by product surface, reduce card nesting, improve contrast, and create job-centered navigation/content hierarchy.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Is the overall information architecture organized around community content and real jobs-to-be-done instead of workflow lists or validation surfaces?
holisticQuestionAnswers.screenshotBackedEvidence: Many entry screens show real community titles, but action/review states fall back to reusable Payment summary, Decision queue, Export steps, Export console, and persona/workflow handoff panels rather than task-specific product IA.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Use documented surfaces such as event detail, announcement composer/inbox, protected request, roster, document center, message thread, ad/no-fill slot, and export wizard.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does the visible UI avoid blocking or major overlap, clipping, crowding, default-scaffold, repeated-card, checklist-modal, and thin-content defects?
holisticQuestionAnswers.screenshotBackedEvidence: Contact-sheet and full-resolution inspection show repeated-card fatigue, checklist-like action panels, crowding in dense chip/card layouts, and low-contrast dimmed action copy on many review screens.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Remove checklist/review panels, increase readable hierarchy, and recapture all affected screens after redesign.

llmVisionReview.summary: B25 cannot pass. The screenshots are fresh and hash-valid, but the UI still exposes generic workflow/action scaffolding on 48 action screens, wrong Payment summary containers on non-payment flows, generic export stepper/console surfaces, demo-like persona handoff screens, and broad repeated-card visual fatigue across the 195-screen set.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does the whole experience feel like a real production community app for the target users, not merely an implemented workflow harness?
holisticQuestionAnswers.screenshotBackedEvidence: 48 screenshots include generic action/review checklist text such as Decision, Change or reject, Saved status and receiver, and "Use the object details below to save, submit, send, pay, or export the right community record."
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Remove workflow-harness action scaffolding and implement domain-native decision surfaces per workflow.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Is the UI modern, easy to use, easy to navigate, and visually appealing for the target persona?
holisticQuestionAnswers.screenshotBackedEvidence: The screenshots use consistent typography and colors, but the visual system is dominated by near-identical stacked cards, dense chip rows, dark panels, and low-contrast lower action sections across unrelated communities.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Differentiate layouts by product surface, reduce card nesting, improve contrast, and create job-centered navigation/content hierarchy.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Is the overall information architecture organized around community content and real jobs-to-be-done instead of workflow lists or validation surfaces?
holisticQuestionAnswers.screenshotBackedEvidence: Many entry screens show real community titles, but action/review states fall back to reusable Payment summary, Decision queue, Export steps, Export console, and persona/workflow handoff panels rather than task-specific product IA.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Use documented surfaces such as event detail, announcement composer/inbox, protected request, roster, document center, message thread, ad/no-fill slot, and export wizard.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does the visible UI avoid blocking or major overlap, clipping, crowding, default-scaffold, repeated-card, checklist-modal, and thin-content defects?
holisticQuestionAnswers.screenshotBackedEvidence: Contact-sheet and full-resolution inspection show repeated-card fatigue, checklist-like action panels, crowding in dense chip/card layouts, and low-contrast dimmed action copy on many review screens.
holisticQuestionAnswers.requiredFix: Remove checklist/review panels, increase readable hierarchy, and recapture all affected screens after redesign.

findings.visibleTextBasis: The current screenshots visibly repeat implementation-style decision scaffolding. The exact visible text appears on 48 action/review screens: "Decision", "Use the object details below to save, submit, send, pay, or export the right community record", "Change or reject", and "Saved status and receiver". This is not a real community interaction model and directly contradicts the B25 bar against workflow harness surfaces.
productDocOrBlueprintBasis: docs/Build Plan V2/Evidence/B25/production-ux-blueprint.md: B25 requires production community product surfaces, modern UI, domain-native primary workflows, and no major repeated-card/checklist/thin-content defects.

Community product docs Sections 5, 6, and 9 define domain-native surfaces and reject checklist modals, generic validation cards, abstract payment rows, technical-only export rows, and generic workflow surfaces.
findings.requiredFix: Replace the shared action/review checklist renderer with domain-specific decision screens. Each affected workflow must show the concrete object, decision data, natural primary action, real alternate/change/reject path, and a durable result/receiver state using copy specific to that community task. Remove the generic Decision/Change-or-reject/Saved-status checklist text from user-facing UI and recapture entry/action/result screenshots.

findings.visibleTextBasis: The screenshots show "Payment summary" as the top surface for facility reservation, announcement, neutral notification, top banner no-fill, ad suppression, sensitive no-fill, in-stream ad, and persona/handoff screens. Product docs call for reservation detail, announcement/feed, notification inbox/detail, sponsored item, top-banner no-fill, sensitive no-fill, and persona-aware app-shell surfaces, not a generic payment shell.

findings.requiredFix: Route non-payment workflows to their documented product surfaces. Facility reservation needs facility/date/status and reserve/cancel state; announcements need body/sender/audience/timing/draft or sent state; ad/no-fill screens need sponsor/disclosure/no-fill layout proof; neutral notification needs sender/body/timestamp/read state. Keep payment summaries only for real payment, dues, checkout, donation, receipt, settlement, entitlement, or registration-payment flows.

findings.visibleTextBasis: The export screenshots repeatedly show "Export steps" and "Export console" cards with abstract step labels. The product docs require export/import preview, schema listing, redaction review, checksum verification, transfer verification, rollback, scope, file counts, destination, preview, retry/cancel/rollback paths, and readable trust indicators. The current surface is closer to a test checklist than a production owner tool.

findings.visibleTextBasis: Across the 195 screenshots, visually distinct community tasks collapse into stacked rounded cards with similar chip rows, large dark panels, and single-hue community themes. Garden RSVP, HOA decisions, Masjid care, soccer roster, chess results, camera critique, social messages, ad-off, and export workflows differ mostly by color/title text. B25 requires modern, domain-native app surfaces organized around real community content rather than a universal card-stack renderer.
productDocOrBlueprintBasis: docs/Build Plan V2/Evidence/B25/production-ux-blueprint.md: B25 requires production community product surfaces, modern UI, domain-native primary workflows, and no major repeated-card/checklist/thin-content defects.

Community product docs Sections 5, 6, and 9 define domain-native surfaces and reject checklist modals, generic validation cards, abstract payment rows, technical-only export rows, and generic workflow surfaces.
findings.requiredFix: Introduce domain-specific layouts and information architecture per surface family: event detail pages, announcement composer/feed/inbox, donation/payment receipt, protected request form, roster/schedule views, document center, message thread, ad/no-fill placement, and export wizard. Vary layout, hierarchy, density, and actions by job while preserving shell consistency. Reduce card nesting, improve contrast, and make primary content visible without repetitive framework panels.
findings.description: The full screenshot set has repeated-card fatigue and weak modern product differentiation.
